name: Iridescent Descent
source:
Why has the narrator awoken in a room with records on the walls? Is there no one to provide guidance aside from this stranger with a cloud over their face, who says: 

[i]"Haven't you heard music can transport you places?"[/i]

[From [url=https://ilyilaice.itch.io/iridescent-descent]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
叙述者为何会在四周墙上挂满唱片的房间里醒来？除了这位面容被云雾遮住的陌生人，再没有人能指引他吗？陌生人说道：

[i]“你没听说过音乐能带人去往别处吗？”[/i]

[来源：[url=https://ilyilaice.itch.io/iridescent-descent]Itch.io[/url]]
